name: parse_accounts
notes: NCSA `accounts` output -> [[account, balance]]: every non-blank line after the first line that fully matches [-\s]{6,} and contains '-' (Python re \s, i.e. Unicode whitespace) is a row; split on whitespace (Python str.split), column 1 is the account, column 2 the balance as text ('' if missing). Later dashed lines are skipped too; lines are split with str.splitlines (\n, \r\n, \r and the other Unicode line breaks). The real DeltaAI case is the @@accounts section of tests/fixtures/deltaai_probe.txt.
